content:
Jamie plans interviews and translates scattered observations into useful
patterns. The question bank in [Conversation kit](/note/notes/interview_kit) is
Jamie's working document for the Neighborhood Atlas.

Jamie and [Noah](/note/people/noah_williams) pair on the data model, and regularly
compare notes with [Elena](/note/people/elena_kowalska) about public-space research.

occurrences.context: Participants: Alex, Jamie, Maya, and Noah.
Alex Morgan and Jamie Chen began by mapping the places that make a neighborhood feel welcoming.
